PROJECT 01 / 05 FLAGSHIP · CREDIT RISK

Credit Risk & Compliance Analytics Platform — Simulated Qatar Bank

STAR SCHEMA · 14 TABLES · 3,000 CUSTOMERS · 100+ DAX MEASURES · 6 REPORT PAGES · SIMULATED DATA (QAR)

A complete bank, built end to end, to show how credit risk, compliance and profitability can be monitored in one place and turned into decisions a credit committee can act on.

QAR 1.76bnLoan Portfolio (simulated)
2.93%NPL Ratio
82.8%Coverage Ratio
91.7%AML False-Positive Rate
84.5%Alert SLA Compliance
42.3%Branch Cost-to-Income
  • The question — Where is loan quality deteriorating, is the bank provisioning enough, and can compliance teams focus on the alerts that matter? Credit, compliance and branch data usually sit in separate reports, so risk shows up late.
  • What I built — A complete simulated Qatar bank in a 14-table star schema (3,000 customers, 14 branches, 3 years in QAR) with 100+ DAX measures, delivered as a 6-page executive dashboard: credit risk, AML/KYC compliance, retail and cards, investments, branch profitability and an executive overview.
  • What the data shows — NPL ratio rose +1.31 pp year on year to 2.93%, with Corporate Finance (4.8%) and Personal Finance (4.5%) carrying the highest NPL concentration, while coverage held at 82.8% and Stage 2 exposure reached 3.3% of the book.
  • Recommendation — Put Corporate and Personal Finance on tighter watch-list review and trigger early-warning on new NPL inflows, so provisioning moves before loans reach Stage 3.
  • Compliance angle — 91.7% of closed AML alerts were false positives and only 6.0% led to an STR, with 84.5% handled inside SLA. Recommendation: tune the noisiest scenarios and route critical alerts first to cut investigator workload.
  • Profitability link — Branch revenue reached 103% of target (+11% year on year) at a 42.3% cost-to-income ratio, tying portfolio quality to branch performance in one view.
  • How I work — Designed and built using AI-assisted workflows to accelerate development, with every measure manually audited and validated against source tables. All data is simulated for demonstration, thresholds are illustrative, and project limitations are fully documented.

Enterprise Financial Suite & Advanced DAX Analytics

MESSY ERP DATA → CLEAN MODEL · 4 REPORT PAGES · $26.74M BUDGET MODELED
$5.74MTotal Revenue
65%Gross Margin
$26.65MEnding Cash Balance
45.31Months Cash Runway
$1.27MTotal AR Outstanding
30.47Days Sales Outstanding
  • Diagnosed 3 critical data-integrity flaws in raw ERP/GL data before building a single visual — sign-convention conflicts, a $26.74M budget dumped into a single "Other" placeholder account, and broken relational links that flattened charts to ±100%.
  • Engineered a programmatic data-cleansing layer entirely in DAX — contextual sign inversion with SUMX, and virtual relationship bridging with TREATAS — to normalize accounting logic without touching the live source database.
  • Cash Flow & Runway page projects a rolling $26.65M ending cash balance and an automated 45.31-month runway estimate, giving leadership forward-looking liquidity visibility.
  • AR Aging & Collections dynamically buckets $1.27M in outstanding receivables (0-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 / 91+ days) using an adaptive date baseline, flagging high-risk accounts on a geographic map.
